Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 p_access varchar2(15);
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
Begin
 
nullchk;
:global.commit_flag:='N';
 
IF :ctrl_blk_2.sel_action not in ('PLACE','RELEASE') then 
 show_error('5020');
 check_package_failure;
ELSE
 --check_access(:ctrl_blk_2.sel_action);
 
 If :ctrl_blk_2.sel_action ='PLACE' then 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from valid_lab_user_access where user_id=:banner.user_id and
 access_class='PLACE' and :ctrl_blk_2.local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_blk_2.local_date+365);
 
 if nCount > 0 then 
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code');
 else
 message('User does not have access to place interdictions');
 end if;
 Else
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from valid_lab_user_access where user_id=:banner.user_id and
 access_class='REMOV' and :ctrl_blk_2.local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_blk_2.local_date+365);
 
 if nCount > 0 then 
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code');
 else
 message('User does not have access to Remove interdictions');
 end if;
 
 End If;
 
END IF;

End;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 l_status varchar2(1);
 iType varchar2(1);
 
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 
 -- execute_trigger('key-nxtblk');
 -- check_package_failure;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code is null
 then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_4');
 clear_block;
 else
 duplicate_inter_check(:ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code,l_status);
 If l_status='D' then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code'); 
 show_error('5203');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 
 -- get the inter type
 select inter_type into iType from valid_interdictions_lab where
 inter_code=:ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code and rownum=1;
 
 go_block('ctrl_inter');
 last_record;
 if :ctrl_inter.inter_code is not null then 
 next_record;
 :ctrl_inter.inter_code:=:ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code;
 :ctrl_inter.inter_type:=iType;
 :ctrl_inter.inter_desc:=:ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_desc;
 else
 :ctrl_inter.inter_code:=:ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code;
 :ctrl_inter.inter_type:=iType; 
 :ctrl_inter.inter_desc:=:ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_desc; 
 end if; 
 :ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code:=null;
 :ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_desc:=null;
 -- :ctrl_inter.inter_type:=null;
 
 :ctrl_blk_2.inter_string:=:ctrl_blk_2.inter_string||IN_QUOTES(:ctrl_inter.inter_code)||','; 
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code');
 End if;
 end if;
exception 
 when others then
 handle_error; 
end;

declare
 v_local_date date := null ;
 temp_desc varchar2(120);
 rg_id RecordGroup;
 rg_name VARCHAR2(40) := 'Unit_list'; 
 
begin
 
 -- clear/delete record group
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF; 


 v_local_date := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 
 -- message(:ctrl_blk_2.void_cancel_id);pause;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code is not null
 then
 begin
 
 
 
 select inter_desc
 into :ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_desc
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where inter_code = :ctrl_blk_2.group_inter_code and inter_type!='B' and
 inter_code in (select inter_code from valid_interdiction_class where inter_class in 
 (
 select inter_class from user_interdiction_class where user_id=:banner.user_id and
 :ctrl_blk_2.local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_blk_2.local_date+365)
 )
 and :ctrl_blk_2.local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_blk_2.local_date+365)
 ) 
 and inter_code not in (select nvl(inter_code,' ') from valid_test_results where :ctrl_blk_2.local_date between eff_date and 
 nvl(term_date, :ctrl_blk_2.local_date+365)) 
 and :ctrl_blk_2.local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_blk_2.local_date+365);
 
 
 
 --:CTRL_BLK_2.SELECTED_TESTS:=:CTRL_BLK_2.GROUP_INTER_CODE;
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1185');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 null;
 --:s_group_test_id_desc := '';
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_count1 number;
 temp_batch_ID VARCHAR2(14);
 v_check_digit VARCHAR2(2);
 v_count number;
Begin 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 --RP Task# 166 05022028
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID), 0) NOT IN (7,13) and NVL(:ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_ID,'M') = 'M'
 then
 show_error('1190');
 --message('Unit Length mut be 7 or 13 Characters.');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 --Make sure user enter only Alpha Numeric only. Check A -> 65, Z -> 90, 0 -> 48, 9 -> 57
 If NVL(:ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_ID,'M') = 'M' then
 FOR i in 1..length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID) LOOP 
 if ASCII(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID, i, 1)) BETWEEN 65 and 90 OR ASCII(SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID, i, 1)) BETWEEN 48 and 57
 then
 null; 
 else
 show_error('5193');
 --message('Unit mut be Alpha Numeric Characters only.');
 EXIT;
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 END LOOP;
 
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID), 0) >= 13 then
 --Check digit should be populated for ISBT/for unit less than 13 digits -- 05082018
 validate_unit_chkdigit ( :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID ,v_check_digit ) ;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := v_check_digit;
 end if;
 
 End if;
 --Task# 166
 
 -- Validate the unit_id
 
 
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 Exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
End;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_UNITS_FOR_REMOVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE POPULATE_UNITS_FOR_REMOVE(pl_inter_codes in varchar2)
IS

 --cursor_number := Exec_SQL.Open_cursor; 
 connection_id EXEC_SQL.CONNTYPE;
 bIsConnected BOOLEAN;
 cursorID EXEC_SQL.CURSTYPE;
 nIgn PLS_INTEGER;
 nRows PLS_INTEGER := 0;
 nTimes PLS_INTEGER := 0;
 mynum NUMBER;
 

v_cursorid integer;
v_rowselect integer;
v_temp varchar2(15);
sqlstr varchar2(1500);
v_check number ;
v_table_name varchar2(50);
v_column_name varchar2(50);
nCount number:=0;
inter_count number:=0;
exist_c number:=0;
v_check_digit varchar2(3);
pl_coll_date date;
l_status varchar2(1);

temp_x varchar2(1);

BEGIN
v_check := 0;

--message('Before pulling the units');


 connection_id := EXEC_SQL.DEFAULT_CONNECTION;
 --message('11');pause;
 bIsConnected := EXEC_SQL.IS_CONNECTED;
 --message('12');pause;
 
 IF bIsConnected = FALSE THEN
 message('No primary connection. Please connect before retrying.');
 RETURN;
 END IF;


 --message('1');pause; 
 cursorID := EXEC_SQL.OPEN_CURSOR;
 
 --message('2');pause;

 sqlstr := ' SELECT unit_id '||
 -- ' INTO '||:unit_details.unit_id||
 ' FROM UNIT_INTERDICTIONS '||
 ' WHERE INTER_CODE IN ('||pl_inter_codes||')'||' and chapter_id='||in_quotes(:global.chapter_id);
 
--message(sqlstr);pause; 

 EXEC_SQL.PARSE(cursorID, sqlstr, exec_sql.V7);
 
 -- message('3');pause;
 
 EXEC_SQL.DEFINE_COLUMN(cursorID, 1, v_temp,15);
 
 --message('4');pause;
 
 nIgn := EXEC_SQL.EXECUTE(cursorID);
 
 go_block('ctrl_units');
 clear_block;
 
 message(' ',no_acknowledge);
 :system.message_level:=10;
 
 

 LOOP
 IF (EXEC_SQL.FETCH_ROWS(cursorID) = 0) THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 
 EXEC_SQL.COLUMN_VALUE(cursorID, 1, v_temp);
 
 -- get the collection date 
 
 begin
 select coll_date into pl_coll_date from units where unit_id=v_temp and rownum=1;
 exception when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 inter_count:=0;
 exist_c:=0;
 
 go_block('ctrl_inter');
 first_record;
 
 Loop
 inter_count:=inter_count+1;
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from unit_interdictions where unit_id=v_temp and inter_code=:ctrl_inter.inter_code;
 if nCount > 0 then
 exist_c:=exist_c+1; 
 end if;
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if; 
 End Loop;

 
 If inter_count=exist_c then -- if the unit has all the listed interdicitons then only display the unit
 
 
 duplicate_unit_check(v_temp,l_status);
 If l_status!='D' then 
 
 go_block('ctrl_units');
 last_record;
 If :CTRL_UNITS.unit_id is not null then
 next_record;
 :CTRL_UNITS.unit_id:=v_temp;
 validate_unit_chkdigit ( v_temp ,v_check_digit ) ;
 :CTRL_UNITS.check_digit:=v_check_digit;
 :CTRL_UNITS.coll_date:=pl_coll_date;
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_count:= nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_count,0)+1;
 Else
 :CTRL_UNITS.unit_id:=v_temp;
 validate_unit_chkdigit ( v_temp ,v_check_digit ) ;
 :CTRL_UNITS.check_digit:=v_check_digit;
 :CTRL_UNITS.coll_date:=pl_coll_date;
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_count:= nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_count,0)+1;
 End If;
 
 -- :ctrl_blk_2.unit_string:=:ctrl_blk_2.unit_string||IN_QUOTES(:ctrl_units.unit_id)||','; 
 
 End If;
 
 End If;
 
 --next_record;
 END LOOP;
 
 
EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(cursorID);
EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CONNECTION;

go_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_id');
set_item_property('ctrl_units.unit_id',insert_allowed,property_false);
set_item_property('ctrl_units.unit_id',update_allowed,property_false);
go_block('ctrl_units');
first_record;
 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(cursorID);
 EXEC_SQL.CLOSE_CONNECTION;
 Message(SQLERRM);pause;
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
END;

 null;
 End If;
 
Exception 
 when others then 
null;
End;
